nvitk.segmentation.mask_ops¶

Binary mask logical operators and mask→image intensity apply.

Functions¶

mask_union(→ nvitk.types.Image | Any)

Voxels where either mask is foreground (OR).

mask_intersection(→ nvitk.types.Image | Any)

Voxels where both masks are foreground (AND).

mask_subtract(→ nvitk.types.Image | Any)

Foreground in mask_a not in mask_b (A B), or overlap only if keep_overlap.

mask_xor(→ nvitk.types.Image | Any)

Symmetric difference (A ⊕ B).

mask_complement(→ nvitk.types.Image | Any)

Logical NOT of mask; optional within ROI limits the complement region.

Apply a segmentation mask to an intensity image.

nvitk.segmentation.mask_ops.apply_mask_to_image(image: nvitk.types.Image | Any, mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, mode: str = 'keep_inside', fill_value: float = 0.0, label_ids: collections.abc.Sequence[int] | None = None) → nvitk.types.Image | Any¶

Apply a segmentation mask to an intensity image.

Parameters:

  • image – Intensity volume (active layer).

  • mask – Segmentation / binary mask on the same grid as image.

  • mode – keep_inside — retain voxels where the mask is foreground; fill the rest. keep_outside — retain voxels where the mask is background; fill the rest.

  • fill_value – Value written into discarded voxels (default 0).

  • label_ids – Optional label ids treated as foreground; None / empty → any nonzero.
